_comment: Hand-edited. Organisers' own pages, read directly (item 72, §3.Z). type: ics = an iCalendar feed; apidae-ot = the tourist office list + event pages, parsed without AI; page = HTML or RSS read and extracted by Gemini WITHOUT grounding. follow = a path pattern: the list page is read, then each linked event page matching it (up to maxFollow, default 25). enabled:false keeps a site on file with the reason it is not read.

sources.name: Office de tourisme du Pays de Fontainebleau
Ville de Fontainebleau
sources.note: RSS feed of the city's agenda since 29/09 (dates parsed exactly, no model; the agenda page was read by Gemini before). Answers HTTP 418 to GitHub Actions (cloud addresses blocked) while answering normally elsewhere. Not worked around: an exception for this URL and our User-Agent was requested from the city on 29/09. Until then the source reports ❌ 418 and the run goes on.

sources.name: ANVL (naturalistes)
sources.note: Only the RSS feed is read. The outings live solely in a 'Booking Activities' calendar whose public data request (admin-ajax, allowed by robots.txt) answers 404 to an identified robot — not worked around. No sitemap entry per outing. Ask ANVL (phase 72c) for the plugin's .ics export link: two clicks in its admin.

sources.name: ANVL sur J'agis pour la nature
sources.note: Added 29/09. The national volunteering platform publishes ANVL's outings, one page each, with date and place; robots.txt allows /structure/ and /activite/. The legitimate route to the outings that anvl.fr only serves through its booking calendar. Activity pages name the real town (the Carreau Franc reserve is in Marolles-sur-Seine, outside the radius).

sources.name: Espaces équestres Henson
sources.note: No agenda: the outings at Henson – Pays de Fontainebleau (Saint-Martin-en-Bière) are sold as shop offers. The 'Évènement' tag page was a news archive for every Henson centre.

sources.name: Communauté de communes Moret Seine & Loing
sources.note: Added 05/10 after the Grez-sur-Loing open studios (2-4/10) were missed. The intercommunal agenda of the villages south and east of the forest (Montigny-sur-Loing, Saint-Mammès, Champagne, Vernou, Villemer, Flagy…): 44 cards on 05/10, machine-written dates read without a model. Office hours and job forums are excluded by title.

sources.name: Festival des Briardises (théâtre amateur)
sources.note: Added 05/10. One performance a night in a different village of the Seine valley (2026: 3-10 October, Champagne, Samoreau, Chartrettes, Bois-le-Roi, Héricy, Thomery), each with date, town, venue and time. The villages scan gave it in Vulaines and Fontaine-le-Port, where it does not play: the programme is read here instead. No robots.txt (404).

sources.name: Grez'arts (ateliers d'artistes de Grez-sur-Loing)
sources.note: Added 05/10: the yearly open studios (2-4/10/2026) were missed by every source. Static page, robots.txt only forbids /images/ and /download/.

sources.name: Amis de la Forêt de Fontainebleau
sources.note: Agenda rendered by JavaScript: the raw page holds no event.

sources.name: Château et jardins de Courances
sources.note: Checked 05/10, when Courances joined the zone as a great site. domainedecourances.com is a Wix site (content rendered by JavaScript); the news page of courances.net answers 403. Events come from the culture scan, which names the château in its question.

sources.name: David Nature
sources.note: robots.txt: Disallow / for every robot. Respected, never read.
